_comment: Per-assembly deviations from the original .csproj Compile lists. Every entry needs a reason.

exclude.CenterWinDialog.cs: Win32 dialog centring; used only by MessageBoxes.WinForms.cs
exclude.MessageBoxes.WinForms.cs: Native WinForms dialog; portable counterpart added
exclude.DynamicTypeDescriptor/DynamicTypeDescrip: WinForms drop-down editor; portable counterpart added
exclude.Editors/FilteredFileNameEditor.cs: WinForms file dialog editor; used only by PrePoMax forms (UI layer)
exclude.Tools.WinForms.cs: WinForms start-up path; portable counterpart added

add.X/Domain/CaeResults/Portable/TestVisibil: Internal FRD reader visible to the shared data regression program

add.CaeModel/FileInOut/Output/Calculix/Therm: PrePoMax-X thermal deck writer (existing X file in the original folder)
add.CaeModel/FileInOut/Input/Netgen/NetgenVo: PrePoMax-X Netgen VOL mesh-data reader (existing X file in the original folder)

exclude.ExecutableJob.Legacy.cs: Windows-only process implementation; replaced by the portable partial
exclude.AnalysisJob.Windows.cs: WMI process-tree termination (Windows only); portable counterpart added

vtkControl._comment: Data subset only (D062): the classes the domain assemblies use. The rendering control itself depends on Windows ActiViz and is ported in Phase C.
